Contact.description: Contact object must contain either a valid mail field or a full address including the following fields: *first_name*, *family_name*, *ba_street*, *ba_city*, *ba_postal_code*.

DuplicateCheckMethod.description:
Defines the method that will be used to check for duplicate contacts to merge with. Possible values are:
auto : A probability algorithm will be used to search for duplicates (Default)
email : Primary email address will be used to search for duplicates
none : No duplicate check will be performed (not recommended)

DuplicateMergeMethod.description:
Defines the method that will be used to merge the conact if a duplicate was found. Possible values are:

update_add: missing fields will be added, existing fields will be overwritten (Default)
update : Given fields overwrite existing fields (with value), missing fields (no value) won't be added
add : only missing fields will be added

ReturnFields.description: Defines additional contact fields, which should be returned in case of success. This makes sense for example, when you have duplicates.

RequestIp.description:
The IPv4 address which belongs to the contact, for example from the request which submitted a form. This field needs to be present when using "flood_limit" or "spam_protection".
  This parameter has to be part of the contact object.

FloodLimit.description: The maximum number of contacts which can be created from the same "request_ip" within an hour. (0 = disabled).

SpamProtection.description: When this is set, the "request_ip" will be checked against a spammer database.

field_type.description: Type of the custom field. Possible types are: "text", "selection", "date", "integer", "float", "checkbox_confirmation", "url".

field_name.description: This name will be used as unique identifier of the field. It can contain letters, numbers and underscores. It will automatically prefixed with "field_". If omitted, it will be generated automatically from the label.

size.description: The size of the text field, displayed in the contact form in the admin area. Default: 30.

allOf.description: A simple text field with up to 255 characters.

field_type_option.description: Type of the selection. Possible values are: "select", "radios", "checkboxes". When this option is set to "checkboxes", the user can select multiple options. Otherwise only one option can be selected.

options.description: Key value pairs with available options. Maximum length is 255 characters per key or value. A key can contain small letters, numbers and underscores. "select" and "radios" can have up to 100 options, while "checkboxes" can only have 50 options.

default_value.description: Defines the default value, selected in the list. This must be the key of an option. In case of "checkboxes", the key(s) must be in an array. For "selection" and "radios" it must be string.
